description: Sets the PRIORITY (p1..p5) on one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state. Spike: POST /incidents/priority with {ids:[...], priority}.

ids.description: Incident ids (the incident `_id` values) to update.

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

name: spike_set_incident_priority
title: Set incident priority
